extraction.title: Troubled waters
extraction.subtitle: How worried should you be about hantavirus? An outbreak on a cruise ship has authorities concerned
extraction.summary: A hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius, sailing from Argentina to Cape Verde, has resulted in three confirmed deaths and several suspected cases. The WHO is leading contact tracing and sequencing, while Spain plans to quarantine remaining passengers at the Canary Islands. The Andes strain involved can spread between humans, but global risk remains low.
